human_review_request.question: This claim may need data that is unavailable in the sandbox. Abort, or proceed with synthetic data and record the limitation?
human_review_request.why_stopped: Requires remeshed FAUST (100 shapes), SCAPE (71 shapes), SHREC19 (44 shapes) at 5k resolution with train/test splits and dense ground-truth correspondences for geodesic error, plus DiffusionNet training and all baseline implementations (DeepShells, GeoFMaps, AFMap, ULRSSM etc.) to claim SOTA mean geodesic error. Datasets require download/license (FAUST/SCAPE) and cannot be synthetically mimicked faithfully for SOTA comparison; ablation Table 4 also requires full training on FAUST+SCAPE.
human_review_request.investigator_position: Proceed on synthetic data; record the limitation explicitly.
human_review_request.critic_concern: Results may not transfer to the paper's real setting.
human_review_request.evidence_a: SOTA near-isometric shape correspondence: Experimentally testable claim that method outperforms prior axiomatic/supervised/unsupervised baselines on remeshed FAUST/SCAPE/SHREC19. Proposed unsupervised EOT+FM method achieves SOTA near-isometric matching (FAUST/SCAPE/SHREC19).
human_review_request.evidence_b: Requires remeshed FAUST (100 shapes), SCAPE (71 shapes), SHREC19 (44 shapes) at 5k resolution with train/test splits and dense ground-truth correspondences for geodesic error, plus DiffusionNet training and all baseline implementations (DeepShells, GeoFMaps, AFMap, ULRSSM etc.) to claim SOTA mean geodesic error. Datasets require download/license (FAUST/SCAPE) and cannot be synthetically mimicked faithfully for SOTA comparison; ablation Table 4 also requires full training on FAUST+SCAPE.
